svg.title: OrderFlow 中文业务流程概览
svg.desc: 从异常订单调查、模型方案与规则反馈，到主管审批、资源复核、幂等修改及结果验证。复杂恢复路径在详细版单独展开。

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: 👤 创建库存不足处理任务

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: 调查订单、库存、采购与约束

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: Agent 基于证据补查与提出方案

div.style: color: rgb(113, 63, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
等待主管审批
LangGraph interrupt 保存中断

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: 复核最新资源、日期与批准内容

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
方案过期
需重新调查和审批

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
稳定操作 ID + 事务操作账本
幂等修改交付计划

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: 查询并核验订单与操作记录

color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
保留可恢复状态
